_comment: Ontario corporate rates from 1 July 2026, when the lower rate fell to 2.2%.

t2_general_rate.source: Ontario general corporate income tax rate, 11.5%. Ontario Budget 2026, Annex; confirmed against CRA, Ontario basic income tax. Checked 2026-09-15.

t2_small_business_rate.source: Ontario lower corporate income tax rate, 2.2%, for days from 1 July 2026. Ontario Budget 2026, Annex: the rate falls from 3.2% to 2.2% effective 1 July 2026, "prorated for taxation years straddling July 1, 2026". Checked 2026-09-15.
